# Fox Blocks

> > Fox Blocks manufactures insulated concrete forms (ICF) for sustainable, energy-efficient building construction across North America.

Fox Blocks, part of Airlite Plastics Company's Sustainable Construction Products Division since 2005, produces ICF building systems using EPS foam technology. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Omaha (NE), Nazareth (PA), Post Falls (ID), and McFarland (CA), serving residential and commercial construction markets throughout North America.
